# Effects

<!-- Generated by `rake docs` from the primitive registry. Do not edit. -->

## add_counters

Put `amount` counters named `counter` on each referenced permanent or player. Any counter name works (+1/+1, -1/-1, loyalty, stun, shield, oil, a keyword, ...; on a player poison, experience, ...); see docs/reference/counters.md for the ones with rules. A player with ten or more poison counters loses the game.

Rules: CR 122.1, CR 122.1f, CR 122.6, CR 613.4c, CR 704.5c

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `counter` | counter name (+X/+Y, -X/-Y or a lowercase word) |
| `amount` | integer |
| `to` | selector |

```json
{
  "add_counters": {
    "counter": "+1/+1",
    "amount": 1,
    "to": {
      "each": "creature",
      "controller": "you"
    }
  }
}
```

## add_mana

You add mana to your mana pool: the fixed mana in `produce`, or `amount` mana of a color you choose as it resolves (`color: "any_one"`: all of one color; `color: "any"`: each mana's color chosen separately, "in any combination of colors"; `"chosen"`: of the color chosen for its source or by it, CR 607.2d). `colors` limits the choice ("add {R} or {G}"). `spend_only` restricts how the mana can be spent (CR 106.6). `until: "end_of_combat"`: you don't lose this mana as steps end until end of combat (CR 702.189a).

Rules: CR 106.1a, CR 106.4, CR 608.2d, CR 605.1a, CR 106.6, CR 500.5, CR 607.2d

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `produce` | mana symbols, e.g. "{R}{R}" |
| `amount` | amount (default 1; with produce: how many times) |
| `color` | any_one | any | chosen |
| `colors` | list of colors to choose from (default all five) |
| `spend_only` | {"spells": card spec, "abilities": card spec} |
| `until` | "end_of_combat" (optional) |

```json
{
  "add_mana": {
    "amount": 2,
    "color": "any_one"
  }
}
```

## add_subtypes

Each referenced permanent gets the `subtypes` in addition to its other types until end of turn (layer 4).

Rules: CR 613.1d, CR 205.1b, CR 611.2a, CR 611.2c

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `subtypes` | list of lowercase subtypes |
| `to` | selector |

```json
{
  "add_subtypes": {
    "subtypes": [
      "warrior"
    ],
    "to": {
      "target": 0
    }
  }
}
```

## additional_phases

Adds `phases` (in order; each "combat" or "main") directly after the current phase of this turn. Phases added after the same phase come most recently created first. An added main phase is a postcombat main phase. `attackers`: only creatures matching this filter can attack during the (first) added combat phase.

Rules: CR 500.8, CR 505.1, CR 508.1c

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `phases` | list of "combat" | "main" |
| `attackers` | creature filter |

```json
{
  "additional_phases": {
    "phases": [
      "combat",
      "main"
    ]
  }
}
```

## additional_triggers

For `duration` (while_source_tapped: for as long as the source remains tapped), each triggered ability of each referenced permanent triggers an additional time.

| --- | --- |
| `to` | selector |
| `duration` | while_source_tapped |

```json
  "additional_triggers": {
    "to": {
      "target": 0
    },
    "duration": "while_source_tapped"
  }
}
```

## airbend

Airbend: exile each referenced permanent or spell; for as long as each card stays exiled, its owner may cast it by paying {2} rather than its mana cost (cast option `via: "effect:<n>"`). The exiled cards are the effect's results.

Rules: CR 701.65a, CR 701.65b, CR 118.9, CR 601.2f

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `to` | selector of permanents and/or spells |

```json
{
  "airbend": {
    "to": {
      "target": 0
    }
  }
}
```

## amass

Amass `subtype` `amount`: if you control no Army creature, create a 0/0 black [subtype] Army creature token; then put `amount` +1/+1 counters on an Army creature you control (chosen if there are several), which becomes a [subtype] too.

Rules: CR 701.47a, CR 701.47b, CR 701.47c, CR 613.1d

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `subtype` | lowercase creature type, e.g. "orc" |
| `amount` | amount |

```json
{
  "amass": {
    "subtype": "orc",
    "amount": 2
  }
}
```

Assimilate each referenced permanent or permanent card: you gain control of it (or put it onto the battlefield under your control) with a +1/+1 counter, and it becomes a Borg artifact creature while it stays on the battlefield. `for`: only cards matching a card spec; `choose: true`: you choose one of them.

Rules: CR 701.72a, CR 701.72b, CR 701.72c, CR 607.2a, CR 205.1b, CR 613.1b, CR 613.1d, CR 614.12a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `to` | selector (permanents, or a target card in a graveyard, or "exiled_with") |
| `for` | card spec (default: any) |
| `choose` | boolean |

```json
{
  "assimilate": {
    "to": {
      "target": 0
    }
  }
}
```

## attach

Attach this Aura or Equipment (the ability's source), or the `attachment` (e.g. a token an earlier effect created, {"result": n}), to the referenced permanent. Nothing happens if it can't legally be attached to it, if it's already attached to it, or if the attachment has left the battlefield.

Rules: CR 701.3a, CR 701.3b, CR 701.3c, CR 301.5c

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `to` | selector naming one permanent: {"target": n}, "self" or {"result": n} |
| `attachment` | selector (default: the source) |

```json
{
  "attach": {
    "to": {
      "target": 0
    }
  }
}
```

## become

Each referenced permanent becomes what the parameters say, for `duration` (end_of_turn, default; indefinite: as long as it stays on the battlefield; while_source_on_battlefield: for as long as this effect's source remains on the battlefield): it has the card `types`, `supertypes` and `subtypes` in addition to its other types (layer 4, "becomes an artifact creature"), its creature types are exactly `creature_types` (layer 4), its colors are `colors` (layer 5), with `loses_abilities: true` it loses all the abilities it had (layer 6; abilities granted later, keyword counters put on it later and this effect's own `keywords` and `abilities` stay, CR 613.7), it has the `keywords` and `abilities` (layer 6: triggered, activated, mana, play_from or additional_land_plays abilities) and its base power and toughness are `base_power_toughness` (layer 7b). A permanent that becomes a creature has its printed power and toughness (a Vehicle's), or 0/0.

Rules: CR 611.2a, CR 611.2b, CR 611.2c, CR 613.1d, CR 613.1e, CR 613.1f, CR 613.4b, CR 613.7b, CR 205.1a, CR 205.1b, CR 301.7b, CR 514.2

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `types` | card types it also has: artifact, creature, enchantment, land |
| `supertypes` | supertypes it also has ("legendary") |
| `subtypes` | subtypes it also has ("in addition to its other types") |
| `creature_types` | list of creature types (replaces the others) |
| `colors` | list of W, U, B, R, G (replaces its colors) |
| `loses_abilities` | true: it loses all abilities ("loses all abilities") |
| `keywords` | list of keywords it gains |
| `base_power_toughness` | {"power": n, "toughness": n} |
| `abilities` | list of abilities it gains |
| `duration` | end_of_turn | indefinite | while_source_on_battlefield |
| `to` | selector |

```json
{
  "become": {
    "types": [
      "creature"
    ],
    "creature_types": [
      "elemental"
    ],
    "colors": [
      "R"
    ],
    "base_power_toughness": {
      "power": 3,
      "toughness": 3
    },
    "keywords": [
      "haste"
    ],
    "to": "self"
  }
}
```

## become_copy

Each referenced permanent becomes a copy of the (first) object `of` refers to, with the `except` modifications, until end of turn (default) or for as long as it stays on the battlefield (`duration: "permanent"`). It keeps its counters, status and other effects; nothing enters or leaves, so no enter or leave abilities trigger. Several copy effects apply in timestamp order.

Rules: CR 707.2, CR 707.4, CR 613.2a, CR 613.7, CR 611.2a, CR 514.2

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `to` | selector (the permanents that become copies) |
| `of` | selector (what they copy) |
| `except` | {"legendary": false, "keywords": [...], "types": [...], "subtypes": [...], "supertypes": [...], "name": ..., "power": n, "toughness": n, "colors": [...]} |
| `duration` | end_of_turn | permanent |

```json
{
  "become_copy": {
    "to": "self",
    "of": {
      "target": 0
    }
  }
}
```

| --- | --- |

## cast

The controller may cast referenced cards (or card copies) now, while this resolves, paying their costs; timing restrictions don't apply. `to`, `for`, `not_types`, `max_mana_value`, `count`, `exile_instead` and `any_mana_type` work as for `cast_free`.

Rules: CR 608.2g, CR 707.12, CR 707.12a, CR 601.2a, CR 601.2f

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `to` | selector |
| `for` | card spec |
| `not_types` | list of card types |
| `max_mana_value` | amount |
| `count` | 1 or "any" |
| `exile_instead` | true or a card spec (as for cast_free) |
| `any_mana_type` | boolean: mana of any type can be spent to cast it (CR 609.4b) |

```json
{
  "cast": {
    "to": {
      "result": 0
    }
  }
}
```

## cast_free

The controller may cast referenced cards without paying their mana costs while this resolves. `to` names the cards ({"result": n}), or a player for the cards in their hand (default: your hand). Only cards matching `for`/`not_types` with mana value up to `max_mana_value` (optional amount) that could be cast now (legal targets). `count`: 1 (default) or "any" (any number, one at a time). X is 0 (CR 107.3b).

Rules: CR 608.2g, CR 118.9, CR 601.2a, CR 107.3b, CR 118.6a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `to` | selector |
| `for` | card spec |
| `not_types` | list of card types |
| `max_mana_value` | amount |
| `count` | 1 or "any" |
| `exile_instead` | true or a card spec: if a spell cast this way (matching it) would be put into a graveyard, it's exiled instead (CR 614.1a) |
| `any_mana_type` | boolean: mana of any type can be spent to cast it (CR 609.4b) |

```json
{
  "cast_free": {
    "to": {
      "result": 0
    },
    "max_mana_value": 3,
    "count": "any"
  }
}
```

## choose_cards

You choose `count` (default 1; "any": any number) cards matching `for` from `from`: a selector (e.g. {"result": 0}, the cards an earlier effect milled) or a player's zone, {"hand": selector} / {"graveyard": selector}. `optional`: you may choose fewer. Then they are put into `put` (`tapped` onto the battlefield, under your control; exiled cards `link`ed to the source). `look`: you look at the whole zone first; `reveal`: "chosen" reveals what you chose, "all" the whole set. `then` runs if a card was chosen, `otherwise` if none was ("if you can't"). `random: true`: the cards are picked at random (the game's random number generator) instead of chosen.

Rules: CR 701.20a, CR 701.20e, CR 400.7j, CR 608.2c, CR 607.2a, CR 118.12, CR 701.9b

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `from` | selector or {"hand"|"graveyard": player selector} |
| `for` | card spec |
| `count` | integer or "any" |
| `optional` | boolean |
| `put` | hand | graveyard | exile | battlefield | library_top | library_bottom |
| `tapped` | boolean |
| `link` | boolean |
| `look` | boolean |
| `random` | boolean |
| `reveal` | chosen | all |
| `then` | list of effects |
| `otherwise` | list of effects |

```json
{
  "choose_cards": {
    "from": {
      "result": 0
    },
    "for": {
      "permanent": true
    },
    "optional": true,
    "put": "hand"
  }
}
```

## copy_card

Create `amount` copies of each card `of` refers to ("self": the source card), in the zone that card is in, owned by you. They are the effect's result, e.g. for `cast_free` or `cast`. A card copy ceases to exist if it is anywhere but the stack or the battlefield (so one that isn't cast now is gone at the next state-based-action check).

Rules: CR 707.12, CR 707.12a, CR 707.10a, CR 704.5d

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `of` | selector (cards) |
| `amount` | amount (default 1) |

```json
{
  "copy_card": {
    "of": {
      "result": 0
    },
    "amount": 2
  }
}
```

## copy_spell

Copy each spell or ability on the stack `of` refers to ("self": the spell this ability or spell belongs to; a `stack_ability` target: an activated or triggered ability) `amount` times. The copies are put on the stack under the referenced player's control (default: you) with the same modes, X, kicker and targets; they aren't cast or activated, and an ability's copy has the same source. With `new_targets: true` the controller may choose new targets for each copy. A copy of a permanent spell becomes a token as it resolves.

Rules: CR 707.10, CR 707.10a, CR 707.10b, CR 707.10c, CR 707.10f, CR 608.3f

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `of` | selector (spells or abilities on the stack) |
| `amount` | amount (default 1) |
| `new_targets` | boolean |
| `to` | selector (default "you") |

```json
{
  "copy_spell": {
    "of": "self"
  }
}
```

## delayed_trigger

Creates a delayed triggered ability with the controller and source of the resolving spell or ability. It triggers only once, the next time `when` happens (e.g. {"step_begins": {"step": "end", "whose": "each"}} for the next end step). Its `effects` may use {"result": n} for what earlier effects of the creating list moved or created; those objects are affected only if they are still where they were put.

Rules: CR 603.7a, CR 603.7b, CR 603.7c, CR 603.7d, CR 603.7e

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `when` | a trigger condition |
| `effects` | list of effects |
| `watch` | selector resolved now (e.g. {"target": 0}): the objects its trigger subject "watched" and its effects' selector "watched" mean ("when that creature dies") |
| `this_turn` | true: it lasts until the end of this turn and triggers each time ("whenever ... this turn", CR 603.7b); "once": only the next time this turn ("at the beginning of the next combat this turn") |

```json
{
  "delayed_trigger": {
    "when": {
      "step_begins": {
        "step": "end",
        "whose": "each"
      }
    },
    "effects": [
      {
        "sacrifice": {
          "to": {
            "result": 0
          }
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## dig

Look at the top `amount` cards of your library (`reveal: "all"`: reveal them). Take `count` (default 1; "all": every matching card, no choice; "any": any number) cards matching `for` and put them into `put` (`tapped` onto the battlefield); `optional`: you may take fewer. `reveal: "chosen"` reveals the cards taken. The rest go to `rest`: "bottom_random" (default), "bottom_any" (in an order you choose) or "graveyard".

Rules: CR 701.20a, CR 701.20e, CR 401.4, CR 400.7j

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `amount` | amount (how many cards) |

| `optional` | boolean |

| `tapped` | boolean |
| `reveal` | none | chosen | all |
| `rest` | bottom_random | bottom_any | graveyard |

```json
  "dig": {
    "amount": 6,

    "optional": true,
    "reveal": "chosen",
    "put": "hand"

}
```

## end_the_turn

Ends the turn: triggered abilities not yet on the stack cease to exist, every object on the stack is exiled (this spell too, so its later effects don't happen), state-based actions are checked, combat ends and the game skips to the cleanup step. Abilities that trigger meanwhile go on the stack during cleanup, followed by another cleanup step.

## may

An optional effect. The controller chooses yes or no as it resolves; yes is offered only if every effect in `effects` can be done fully. On yes, `effects` then `then` ("if you do") happen; on no, `otherwise` ("if you don't"). Nested effects may name the results of earlier effects of the enclosing list.

Rules: CR 118.12, CR 118.3, CR 608.2d, CR 608.2e

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `effects` | list of effects (the optional part) |
| `then` | list of effects |
| `otherwise` | list of effects |
| `chooser` | who decides (default: the controller): a selector naming a player, or a permanent whose controller decides (e.g. {"target": 0}), or "active_player" |

```json
{
  "may": {
    "effects": [
      {
        "discard": {
          "amount": 1
        }
      }
    ],
    "then": [
      {
        "draw": {
          "amount": 1
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## pay

You may pay `cost` (a list of costs: mana, life, discarding, sacrificing, a `one_of` choice, ...) as it resolves; `mana`, `life` and `waterbend` are shorthands for one cost. If you do, `then` happens; if you don't, `otherwise`. Paying mana works like paying a spell's cost (mana abilities may be activated; a `waterbend` cost may also be paid by tapping artifacts and creatures, CR 701.67a); a cost that can't be paid can't be chosen (CR 118.3). For another player paying, see `counter_unless_pays`.

Rules: CR 118.12, CR 118.12a, CR 118.3, CR 119.4, CR 605.3a, CR 701.67a, CR 701.67c

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cost` | list of costs, e.g. [{"one_of": [{"sacrifice_permanent": {"filter": "artifact"}}, {"discard": {}}]}] |
| `mana` | mana cost string, e.g. "{1}" |
| `life` | integer |
| `waterbend` | mana cost string: "unless you waterbend {2}" |
| `then` | list of effects |
| `otherwise` | list of effects |

```json
{
  "pay": {
    "mana": "{1}",
    "then": [
      {
        "draw": {
          "amount": 1
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## play_permission

A player may play (`play: "play"`, default) or cast (`"cast"`) each referenced exiled card matching `for`/`not_types`, paying its costs and following timing rules, for `duration`: end_of_turn (default), end_of_your_next_turn or while_exiled. With `choose: "one_per_owner"` only one chosen card per owner. `to_player`: who may play it, "controller" (default, the effect's controller), "owner" (the card's owner) or a player selector (a face-down card: only someone who may look at it). `cost_increase`: spells cast this way cost that much generic mana more. `any_mana_type: true`: mana of any type can be spent to cast those spells.

Rules: CR 611.2a, CR 601.3, CR 305.1, CR 400.7, CR 514.2, CR 601.2f, CR 108.3, CR 406.3b, CR 609.4b

| `play` | play | cast |
| `for` | card spec |
| `not_types` | list of card types |
| `choose` | one_per_owner |
| `to_player` | controller | owner | player selector |
| `cost_increase` | integer >= 1 |
| `any_mana_type` | boolean |
| `exile_instead` | true or a card spec: if a spell cast this way (matching it) would be put into a graveyard, it's exiled instead (CR 614.1a) |

```json
    "to": {
      "result": 0
    },
    "duration": "end_of_your_next_turn"
  }
}
```

## prevent_damage

For the `duration` (end_of_turn by default, until_your_next_turn, or while_source_on_battlefield: for as long as this effect's source remains on the battlefield), damage that would be dealt to the referenced players and permanents (`to`, fixed as it resolves) or to those matching `to_each` as the damage is dealt (a damage scope seen from the controller, e.g. {"each": "creature", "controller": "you"}), and/or by the referenced sources (`by`; "chosen_source": a source the controller chooses as it resolves) is prevented (`combat`: combat | noncombat only). With `next`, it is a shield that prevents only the next that much damage; with `next_time: true` it prevents only the next damage event it applies to. `then`: effects right after it prevents damage, reading {"triggering": "amount"} (the damage prevented), "object" (the source) and "player" (its controller).

Rules: CR 615.1, CR 615.3, CR 615.5, CR 615.7, CR 615.8, CR 609.7a, CR 611.2a, CR 611.2b, CR 611.2c

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |

| `to_each` | damage scope (recipients, as damage is dealt) |
| `by` | selector (sources) | "chosen_source" |
| `combat` | combat | noncombat |
| `next` | amount (a shield) |
| `next_time` | boolean |
| `duration` | end_of_turn | until_your_next_turn | while_source_on_battlefield |
| `then` | list of effects |

```json
  "prevent_damage": {
    "to": {
      "target": 0
    },
    "combat": "combat"
  }
}
```

## recruit

Each referenced player (default: you) recruits: draws a card, then discards a card; if a nonland card was discarded, they create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token.

| `to` | player selector (default you) |

```json
{
```

## reflexive_trigger

Creates a reflexive triggered ability ("when you do, ...") that triggers immediately, with the controller and source of the resolving spell or ability. Its `targets` are chosen as it's put on the stack; its `effects` may name the results of earlier effects of the creating list. With `if`, it triggers only when the condition holds ("when excess damage is dealt this way").

Rules: CR 603.12, CR 603.12a, CR 603.7d, CR 603.7e, CR 603.3d

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `targets` | list of target filters |
| `effects` | list of effects |
| `if` | condition |
| `divide` | amount divided among the targets as it's put on the stack (CR 601.2d) |

```json
{
  "reflexive_trigger": {
    "targets": [
      "any_target"
    ],
    "effects": [
      {
        "deal_damage": {
          "amount": 2,
          "to": {
            "target": 0
          }
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## return_choice

Each referenced player (default: you) returns `count` (default 1; "any": any number) permanents they control matching `filter` to their owners' hands, chosen by them in turn order starting with the active player (not targeted); all move at once.

## return_to_battlefield

Put each referenced card that is in exile or a graveyard onto the battlefield under its owner's control (`under: "you"`: under the controller's), tapped if `tapped: true`. A card that is no longer in the zone it was expected in, or isn't a permanent card, stays where it is. `transformed: true`: it enters with its back face up; a card that isn't double-faced, or whose back face isn't a permanent, stays where it is.

Rules: CR 400.7, CR 400.4a, CR 110.2, CR 111.8, CR 603.7c, CR 614.1c, CR 122.6, CR 712.11a, CR 712.11b

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `to` | selector (usually {"result": n}) |
| `tapped` | boolean |
| `transformed` | boolean |
| `under` | owner | you |
| `counters` | {counter name: n}: it enters with these counters ("with a +1/+1 counter on it") |

```json
{
  "return_to_battlefield": {
    "to": {
      "result": 0
    }
  }
}
```

```json
  }
}
```

## reveal_until

Reveal cards from the top of your library until `count` (an amount, default 1) cards matching `for` are revealed (or the library runs out). Put those into `put` (`tapped` onto the battlefield, under your control) and the rest to `rest` (default the bottom in a random order).

Rules: CR 701.20a, CR 401.4, CR 400.7j

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `for` | card spec |
| `count` | amount |
| `put` | hand | battlefield |
| `tapped` | boolean |
| `rest` | bottom_random | bottom_any | graveyard |

```json
{
  "reveal_until": {
    "for": {
      "types": [
        "land"
      ]
    },
    "count": 2,
    "put": "battlefield",
    "tapped": true
  }
}
```

The controller sacrifices each referenced permanent they control (it goes to its owner's graveyard; it isn't destroyed, so indestructible doesn't stop it).

| `to` | selector |

```json
    "to": {

  }
}
```

## sacrifice_choice

Each referenced player (default: you) sacrifices `count` (default 1; "any": any number) permanents they control matching `filter`, chosen by them in turn order starting with the active player; all are sacrificed at once. The `filter`'s `controller` and `other` restrictions are relative to the effect's controller and source.

Rules: CR 701.21a, CR 101.4, CR 118.3

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `filter` | a filter, e.g. {"creature": {"token": false}} |
| `count` | integer or "any" |
| `to` | selector of players |

```json
{
  "sacrifice_choice": {
    "filter": "creature",
    "to": "each_opponent"
  }
}
```

Look at the top `amount` cards of your library; put any number on the bottom and the rest on top in any order.

Rules: CR 701.22a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `amount` | integer |

```json

    "amount": 2
  }
```

## search_library

Search your library for up to `count` cards matching `for`, then put them into your hand (or onto the battlefield, tapped if `tapped`, with `counters`) and shuffle. With a stated quality you may find fewer (or none); a search for just "a card" must find one if it can. `reveal` shows the found cards to every player. `searcher` names another player who searches their own library (e.g. {"controller_of": {"target": 0}}); `may: true` lets the searcher decline (then nothing is shuffled).

Rules: CR 701.23a, CR 701.23b, CR 701.23d, CR 701.23e, CR 701.20a, CR 701.24a, CR 701.24b, CR 118.12, CR 110.2a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `for` | card spec: "card" (default), {"types"|"subtypes"|"supertypes": [...], "name": "..."} or {"any_of": [spec, ...]} |
| `count` | integer (default 1), "any" (any number) or an amount ("up to that many") |
| `put` | "hand" (default) or "battlefield" |
| `tapped` | true: the cards enter tapped (with put: battlefield) |
| `counters` | {counter name: n}: the cards enter with these counters (with put: battlefield) |
| `reveal` | true: reveal the found cards |
| `searcher` | selector of the searching player (default "you") |
| `may` | true: the searcher may choose not to search |

```json
{
  "search_library": {
    "for": {
      "supertypes": [
        "basic"
      ],
      "types": [
        "land"
      ]
    },
    "reveal": true
  }
}
```

## transform

Transform each referenced permanent (default: this one): turn it over so its other face is up. It stays the same object, and effects on it keep applying. Nothing happens to a permanent that isn't a double-faced card or token, or whose other face is an instant or sorcery. An ability of the permanent transforms it only if it hasn't transformed since the ability was put on the stack.

Rules: CR 701.27a, CR 701.27c, CR 701.27d, CR 701.27e, CR 701.27g, CR 712.15

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `to` | selector (default "self") |

```json
    "to": "self"
  }
}
```
